name: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Ltd
title: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Ltd - 544717 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: CleanMax added about 1,400 MW in FY26 with 5.7 GW contracted and guides at least 1,500 MW for FY27, but a 525 MW CTU project in Rajasthan faces 30% curtailment at Bikaner 2, and DSM rules are an unquantified risk.

capex.quote: we would have at least 1,500 MW or 1.5 GW of RE Power Sales capacity addition in financial year 26-27

triggers.label: Bikaner 2 curtailment ~30%
triggers.quote: In that substation, the curtailment number is about 30% today, Puneet.

triggers.label: FY27 capacity addition ≥1,500 MW
triggers.quote: we would have at least 1,500 MW or 1.5 GW of RE Power Sales capacity addition in financial year 26-27

triggers.label: FY26 commissioning ~1,400 MW
triggers.quote: we built 1.4 GW, we also fully replenished that pipeline by having 1.4 GW of contract

triggers.label: Module cost pass-through via tariffs
triggers.quote: if the module cost goes up because of making cells in India, then that passes on to a customer in terms of higher tariff

guidance.metric: RE Power Sales capacity addition FY27
guidance.quote: we would have at least 1,500 MW or 1.5 GW of RE Power Sales capacity addition in financial year 26-27

red_flags.label: CTU curtailment at Bikaner 2 ~30%
red_flags.quote: In that substation, the curtailment number is about 30% today, Puneet.

red_flags.label: DSM rules impact not quantified
red_flags.quote: our own internal calculations of impact are not mature enough to share with an external investing audience yet

red_flags.label: Net debt ~INR9,600 crores; reported PAT thin
red_flags.quote: the net debt number of ~INR9,600 crores for the end of the year is broadly in line with what the capacity addition is

evasions.quote: we would hesitate to make any bold bets on what we can achieve
we are bound to disclose only as much as is there in our press release
our own internal calculations of impact are not mature enough to share
